status.en: 9 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 47% fewer than the week before, most of them in Baghdad, Kirkuk and Fallujah.
status.nb: 9 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 47 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Baghdad, Kirkuk og Fallujah.

summary.en: Iraqi security forces have dismantled a drug-trafficking network, arresting 31 suspects, while Prime Minister Al-Zaidi has taken direct control of the intelligence service and is negotiating pipeline and oil export talks with Damascus. Iranian-linked attacks continue, including an Iranian strike that prompted a Navy corpsman and Marine Raiders to rescue French soldiers from a burning building, and a memorial was unveiled in Erbil for victims of the 2024 Iranian missile attack. Chinese missiles have been reported in Iraq, adding an external dimension to the conflict. 396 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Irakiske sikkerhetsstyrker har demontert et narkotikasmuglingsnettverk, arrestert 31 mistenkte, mens statsminister Al-Zaidi har tatt direkte kontroll over etterretningstjenesten og forhandler om rørlednings‑ og oljeeksportavtaler med Damaskus. Iransk-tilknyttede angrep fortsetter, inkludert et iransk angrep som førte til at en marinekorpskorporal og Marine Raiders reddet franske soldater fra en brennende bygning, og et minnesmerke ble avduket i Erbil for ofrene for det iranske missilangrepet i 2024. Kinesiske missiler er blitt rapportert i Irak, noe som gir konflikten en ekstern dimensjon. 396 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Iraqi conflict
background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
